dataset_source: The exact available external datasets in MGGBC-BLIND-20260822-v1; no replacements.

measured_methods.name: NGBC
measured_methods.paper: An adaptive density clustering approach with multi-granularity fusion, Information Fusion, 2024
measured_methods.settings: Author algorithm without label input; StandardScaler as in author Test_Split.py; no tuned parameter.
measured_methods.eligibility: n <= 2000 only, predeclared because the author implementation explicitly forms an n-by-n distance matrix. Larger datasets are marked resource-ineligible, not replaced.

measured_methods.name: EKM
measured_methods.paper: An Equilibrium Approach to Clustering: Surpassing Fuzzy C-Means on Imbalanced Data, IEEE Transactions on Fuzzy Systems, 2025
measured_methods.settings: Author EKM Python estimator; StandardScaler; alpha='dvariance'; scale=2.0; n_init=30; max_iter=500; tol=1e-3; random_state=0.

audited_but_not_measured.name: SAGBC
audited_but_not_measured.paper: Structure-Aware Granular Ball Clustering, Information Sciences, 2026
audited_but_not_measured.reason: The released script is a hard-coded million-point Spark experiment: it references an undefined SparkContext, a local C:/Users path, and fixed k=5000/K=5. Converting it into a general estimator would be a new reconstruction rather than executing the authors' implementation.

fairness_disclosure: EKM is given the ground-truth number of classes, which favors EKM. NGBC and AdaptiveMGGBC infer their output cluster count. Targets are used only after predictions, except for supplying K to EKM as required by its API.
timing: One warm-up plus five fresh runs; median wall-clock seconds; preprocessing included.

tradeoff_assessment.quality: ARI is primary; ACC and NMI secondary.
tradeoff_assessment.pareto: Method A Pareto-dominates B on a dataset only if A has ARI >= B and runtime <= B, with at least one strict inequality.
tradeoff_assessment.aggregate_advantage: AdaptiveMGGBC retains a defensible tradeoff advantage only if it Pareto-dominates each measured recent baseline on at least half of their mutually eligible datasets, or has both a better median ARI rank and a better median runtime rank.
